001_h1: We test the framework in practice.
002_p: ME=WE is not a fixed doctrine. It is a working hypothesis we refine through every workshop, project, and neighbor story — evidence about what actually shifts between people, gathered as we practice.
006_p: Every studio is an experiment — the six-stage Arc tested against real rooms, then adjusted from what we observe.
008_p: Drawing on relational science, systems thinking, art, and ecology to keep the pattern honest — not one discipline's claim.
010_p: What each IN-Collective learns returns to the network, so the framework grows through many hands rather than one.
